# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2005

**Kautu. Bayan sa Binagong (Revised) Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01**

## Summary

Appropriation Ordinance (Revised Supplemental Budget) No. 01 (Kautusang Bayan sa Binagong (Revised) Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01), Series of [[2005]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on December 19, 2005. This is a revised supplemental budget ordinance amending the original Supplemental Budget Ordinance No. 01 (Karagdagang Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01, Series of 2005) to adjust appropriation amounts. It revises the total budget from Twenty-Six Million Eight Hundred Ninety-Six Thousand Three Hundred Fifty-Six Pesos and Eighty-Three Centavos (P26,896,356.83) to Twenty-Five Million Four Hundred Eighty-Six Thousand Seven Hundred Eighty Pesos and Thirty-Seven Centavos (P25,486,780.37) for use in implementing government plans and programs for [[2006]].

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1** — Revenue sources: The municipality shall collect from locally-sourced revenue estimated at Four Million Two Hundred Forty-One Thousand Four Hundred Ninety-One Pesos and Eighty-Eight Centavos (P4,241,491.88), plus Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) of Twenty-Two Million Six Hundred Fifty-Four Thousand Eight Hundred Sixty-Five Pesos (P22,654,865.00), for a total of P26,896,356.83 for fiscal year [[2006]].
- **Section 2** — The revised total appropriation is Twenty-Five Million Four Hundred Eighty-Six Thousand Seven Hundred Eighty Pesos and Thirty-Seven Centavos (P25,486,780.37), to be used for municipal government expenditures, with un-appropriated balance of One Million Four Hundred Nine Thousand Seven Hundred Seventy-Six Pesos and Fifty-One Centavos (P1,409,776.51).
- **Section 3** — Full provision for all statutory and contractual obligations shall be included in the budget.
- **Section 4** — Aid to component barangays set at P39,000.00 in conformance with the code requirement of at least P1,000.00 per barangay to be appropriated.
- **Section 5** — Reduction of appropriation on salaries and wages to comply with [[Sec-325-RA7160|Section 325]](a), the 53% general limitation as a 5th class municipality.
- **Section 6** — Five percent (5%) calamity appropriation amounting to One Million Tatlong Daan Tatimpu't Siyam na Libo Walong-Piso at Walumpu't Dalawang Sentimos.
- **Section 7** — Two percent (2%) budget allocation for the discretionary fund of the Municipal Mayor and the 10% Development Fund.
- **Section 8** — The Revised Supplemental Budget shall take effect upon its inclusion in and approval of the [[2006]] Proposed Annual Budget of the Pitogo municipal government.
- **Section 9** — This ordinance shall supersede Kautusang Bayan sa Binagong (Revised) Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01, and shall take effect on January 1, [[2006]].
- **Section 10** — Approved on December 19, 2005 at Pitogo, Quezon.
